_comment: HMTc computed-style acceptance spec. Values are the design canon (docs/design-canon/) adapted to the cert palette (#9f2727 accent, not the Index's #8b2a4a). Assertions run on the RENDERED page via tools/check-v3.mjs — never against source SCSS. Grow this file whenever a page's presentation changes (CONTENT-RULES.md §3.5), including `absent: true` for markup that was removed.

/.src: design nesting: main > div[background:#faf7f4] is the content canvas that the analyte cards sit on

/.note: cards stay white on the cream canvas; #faf7f4/#fffdfb is ΔE 2.12 — if this ever equals body, the panel has lost its separation

/articles/lead-and-cadmium-in-dark-choco.note: the citation marker is the burgundy accent, NOT the blue link colour. If this reads #1c43ad an older internal-link rule is winning — delete it, do not out-specify (FIDELITY §1).
the PDF-edition download is no longer inline in the reading surface; the generators emit `pdf:` frontmatter and NO body card (CONTENT-RULES §3.5 presentation change).
the Download PDF affordance now lives in the right rail (Rail.tsx PdfCard), driven by the page's `pdf` frontmatter — one home for it sitewide.

the citation slide-over (SourceCitationPanel) is mounted top-level (quartz.layout.ts afterBody, NOT the rail — so the fixed overlay renders at every width); citationPanel.inline.ts fills and reveals it on inline-citation click. This is the layout-liveness assertion: if 0, the mount was dropped and the inline script never ships.
the panel is a right-anchored fixed slide-over, not an in-rail card.
closed state: the panel is off-screen (transform: translateX(100%)) and visibility:hidden until a citation is clicked — NOT display:none, which would kill the slide transition.
the backdrop scrim sibling that the drawer slides in over.

/standards/infant-formula-powder.note: canonical burgundy table head. If not burgundy, a duplicate .wiki-content table rule is winning — delete the loser (FIDELITY §1), never out-specify.
no-bold rule (CONTENT-RULES §7): <strong>/<b>/** render at normal weight.
no inline bold on the reading surface. tools/design-lint.mjs blocks this at build; this is the rendered backstop.

the burgundy manual hero band — the frontmatter-driven HeroBand, ported from the canvas isManual screen.
the 'Standard' KIND badge (type: standard), matching the approved canvas isManual chip.

the hero dek comes from `description` frontmatter — set explicitly, never auto-derived, and never repeated as body prose.
NO hand-rolled hero <h1> in the body — the title is the HeroBand's. A body <h1> is the old duplicate-title defect (design-lint blocks it; this is the rendered backstop).
the master limit matrix uses the canonical burgundy table head (from .wiki-content thead, not inline).
no inline bold on the reading surface (design-lint blocks this; rendered backstop).
no-bold rule: <strong>/<b>/** render at normal weight.
the manual PDF is not inline in the body; it is the right-rail PdfCard (from `pdf` frontmatter).
the Download PDF affordance is the right-rail PdfCard — one home for it sitewide.
the 'On this page' rail sticks below the top-bar.
